name: oot_enemy_tailpasaran
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Tailpasaran in Majora's Mask: an electric worm that rises from the floor and chases you. Its head is armoured, so hit the tail; a sword gets shocked, a stick or a boomerang does not. Custom enemy oot.tailpasaran (no soul, as in Ship). Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
